label: TP
reason: Both alerts involve user-controlled data reaching the HTML sink via 'bar' variable. The XSS alert (java/xss) and format string alert (java/tainted-format-string) both track 'bar' from Referer header input through URL decoding and Test.doSomething(), with no observed encoding/escaping before use in response.getWriter().format().

evidence.note: User-supplied Referer header flows into 'param' via getHeaders(), URL decoding, and Test.doSomething() transformation
Unencoded 'bar' value used in response.getWriter().format() leading to potential XSS/format string vulnerability
